title: Positive refinement component data
statement: Let X be a topological space, K and C abelian sheaves, ι : K → C monic, and isoC identify C with the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let U_i be finitely many compact opens, and g a map from the coproduct of j_(U_i)! Z into K [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. There exists a finite signed partition record: compact opens A_j with parent indices p(j), opens Z_i, and U_i = Z_i union the pairwise disjoint A_j with p(j)=i; Z_i is disjoint from those A_j and every piece lies in its parent U_i. Let s_i be the unit image of the i-th component of g. Its restriction to Z_i is zero. There are positive integer labels c_j, integers sign_j, and maps f_j : j_(A_j)! Z → K whose unit images under ι and isoC are constant c_j. The restriction of s_(p(j)) to A_j equals sign_j times the unit image of f_j. These data do not include a factorization map between the coproducts.

proof.text: Evaluate each coproduct component on its canonical unit to obtain s_i. Apply the unit-compatible comparison [lem-sc-constant-sheaf-locally-constant-unit-comparison] to its image under ι followed by isoC. For each integer value take the image in X of the corresponding fibre in U_i. Mathlib IsLocallyConstant.isClopen_fiber and IsClosed.isCompact show these fibres are compact opens; LocallyConstant.range_finite gives finite ranges. Index the nonzero fibres by the finite dependent sum of their parent index and nonzero value, and use Fintype.equivFin to reindex by Fin n. Equal-parent fibres are disjoint, the zero fibre is disjoint from nonzero fibres, and the fibre union is U_i, including empty domains and families. Naturality and unit compatibility identify the restriction of each image section with the constant unit of its fibre value.

The proved private helper extension_integer_section constructs from any section t over an open A a morphism j_A! Z → K whose canonical unit maps to t. Explicitly integer multiplication by restrictions of t is a constant-presheaf map into K restricted to A. Lift it using sheafifyLift, apply abelianOpenExtensionByZero and compose with abelianOpenCounit [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. The two toSheafify_sheafifyLift formulas, toSheafify_naturality and the direct-sum counit formula prove the unit equation. For a nonzero fibre value a, apply this construction to sign(a) times the restricted s_i. The integer identity sign(a)*a=natAbs(a) proves hv, and sign(a)^2=1 proves hsigned. On zero fibres, naturality and the comparison give zero image; injectivity of the monic map on sections proves hzero. Assemble all fields of PositiveRefinementData, without changing its signature.

proof_origin.place: First proof paragraph; Q3 formalizes all finite-fibre, sign-normalization and extension counit calculations, using the unit-compatible version of P3's proved comparison construction.

theorem positive_refinement_data
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (K C : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (ι : K ⟶ C) [Mono ι]
    (isoC : C ≅ (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (m : ℕ) (U : Fin m → Opens X)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsCompact (U i : Set X))
    (g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K) :
    ∃ d : PositiveRefinementData X K C ι isoC m U g, True
